summary: Quiet week for the machine, loud week for prices. No funnel stage ran (campaign PAUSED since 2026-09-13, radar since 2026-09-01); the week's only commits are five weekday fetches and the 2026-11-09 smoke probe, and the last analytical commit is still the BDX red team of 2026-09-15, 60 days back. The ledger holds no routine fire after 2026-11-01 12:13Z except last Saturday's digest, 13 days of silence from the two paused routines, so they were either disabled on claude.ai or stopped firing; the repo cannot say which. Stale stages, named: radar 74 days without intake, heat and scenarios last written 2026-09-13/14, 8 of 9 agents with no ledger evidence in 21 days. The one dated catalyst of the month passed unswept: the China rare-earth export-control suspension expired 2026-11-10 (EVT-20260831-02) and nothing on disk says whether it lapsed or was extended; its card SIG-20260901-02 is 54 days past review_by. Click queue: EMPTY. Live artifact version 1794058004-0293 (published 2026-11-07 13:26:44Z, so last Saturday's republish did land and cleared the three stale clicks); queue_check.py said NOT ATTRIBUTED, the page was read, both the queue and edits blocks are empty. Indicators: no new trip (17 on file, unchanged), but a broad drawdown on 2026-11-04 to 11-06 set new 52-week lows in names the scenarios watch: CMI 448.58 and CRWV 43.66 on 11-05, DKNG 18.51 on 11-06, Hanwha Ocean 45,550 on 11-09; CAT touched 553.64 on 11-05, 1.4% above its 546.13 low and 8.6% above the top of its would-buy zone, then bounced to 598.88 (11-09). NVDA printed 168.89 on 2026-11-10, 2% above its 165.17 low and 28% under the new-high level that tripped S3 in October. Against that, ACM, the only INVESTABLE name, rose to 70.50 on 2026-11-13 (both sources agree), 0.50 under its 71.00 zone ceiling. HALO fell from 122.96 to 103.63 in one session (2026-11-06) and its review is due tomorrow. Reviews: GD, WST, CAT, AON overdue, STE joined them on 2026-11-13, HUBB, NVT and HALO fall due 2026-11-15. Fifteen of the 18 signal cards reach review_by between 2026-11-28 and 2026-11-30 with radar paused. Feeds: 19 of 20 sources ok, Federal Reserve press releases failing for the third digest running. Shadow book: 81 rows, none graded, earliest review_at 2026-11-26. Deferred backlog: 128 OPEN by exact count, newest row 2026-10-31; last week's digest said 126, which was a miscount, not a decrease.

ranked.title: The rare-earth suspension expired on 2026-11-10 and the repo does not know what happened
ranked.case: SIG-20260901-02 exists because of one date: calendar event EVT-20260831-02, the expiry of China's rare-earth export-control suspension on 2026-11-10, status still PROMOTED. That date passed four days ago with radar paused and no refresh, so whether the suspension lapsed, was extended or was replaced is not on disk, and the card is 54 days past its review_by of 2026-09-21. The only evidence the repo holds is price: 300748.SZ, the chain's tripped S1 indicator (below 32.00), printed 24.63 on 2026-11-10 and 23.97 on 2026-11-13 against a 22.12 low and a 41.16 high. That is no spike through the expiry, which is consistent with S1 (normal band) but is a single-source price, not a reading of the policy outcome. What the weekend decides: a local `refresh data/signals/SIG-20260901-02.json` with a web search on the outcome. It is the cheapest high-value fact the repo lacks, and every scenario probability on rare-earth-separation is stale until it lands.

It rose 5.7% in a week in which CAT, CMI, NVDA and CRWV all fell, and it now sits 0.50 under the ceiling and 9.50 over the floor, with the 52-week low unchanged at 58.02. The tripped S5 indicators (58.52 on 2026-09-24) stand as records of the low. The red-team caution still applies: AECOM was marked down twice for disclosed reasons (the November 2025 guidance cut and August 2026's 337 million dollar legacy-contract charge). What the weekend decides: the entry window the dive defined is nearly closed from above. Either act inside it or refresh the dive before 2026-12-04 to see whether the zone should move; the machine has no opinion newer than 2026-09-06.

It then bounced to 598.88 on 11-09 (yfinance) and 584.67 on 11-10 (stockanalysis, single source). ranked.title: Neocloud chain: CoreWeave set a new low at 43.66 and NVDA has given back the whole S3 trip
ranked.case: Two indicators stand tripped on neocloud-export-compliance and this week they stopped pointing the same way. S1 (CRWV below 70, read as a compliance deadline priced as going-concern risk) deepened: CRWV closed 43.66 on 2026-11-05, a new 52-week low, and 48.98 on 11-09 (both sources agree), down from 60.74 on 10-29. S3 (NVDA above 235.74, a new high on compliance-as-share-protection) tripped at 239.24 on 2026-10-06 and is now fully reversed: NVDA printed 181.60 on 11-05 and 168.89 on 11-10 (173.73 stockanalysis on 11-11), 28% under the level and 2% above its 165.17 52-week low. The trips are permanent records, so the page still shows S3 as tripped; the live reading says the S3 story is not what the market is pricing. No heat or scenario run has touched this chain since 2026-09-13/14 and the card's review_by is 2026-11-30. What the weekend decides: whether to re-run `run scenarios neocloud-export-compliance` so the probabilities reflect a month in which S1 and S3 diverged.

ranked.title: Methanol: shipyards made new lows, Vopak a new high, and the IMO vote is still unswept
ranked.case: The split inside this chain widened. Hanwha Ocean 042660.KS (S2, 70,000 KRW level) closed 45,550 on 2026-11-09, a new 52-week low, and 47,450 on 11-10, 32% under the level; HD Korea Shipbuilding 009540.KS (S5, 330,000 level) printed 244,000 on 11-10 against its 231,500 low. Royal Vopak VPK.AS (S3, 49.00 level) closed 55.00 on 2026-11-12, which is its 52-week high. All three are single-source yfinance prints. So the terminal leg keeps compounding while the newbuild leg keeps de-rating, which is the S3 shape, not S2 or S5 alone. The fact that would explain it is still missing: EVT-20260901-01, the IMO extraordinary MEPC reconvene of 2026-10-01 on the Net-Zero Framework, is WATCHING and unswept six weeks after the date. The chain's one price instrument (KRBN, on eu-maritime-decarbonization-mandates) is still unrated. What the weekend decides: one local web search on the IMO outcome settles more here than any price.
